decisions.reason: Building on the established offer and central to the announced direction, high prior investment and public commitment make management persist.
Reusable carriers are explicitly part of the firm's stated heading, so centrality and visible commitment keep the product.
As a multifunctional packaging wafer, it is central to the announced direction and its recent launch allows disappointing results to be attributed to temporary causes.
Close to the established offer and launched as a public brand, the product benefits from sunk costs and the need to justify the visible commitment.
Distant from the established offer and not central to the announced direction, disappointing results are harder to attribute to temporary causes, weakening escalation.
